title: Web Task
description: Browser tasks, sessions, and recipes for MCP and HTTP automation.
summary: Browser tasks, sessions, and recipes for MCP and HTTP automation.
offersHint: Browser tasks, sessions, and recipes for MCP and HTTP automation. · Packages: npm:web-task-api · Env vars: BROWSER_CHANNEL, BROWSER_USER_DATA_DIR, CLIPROXY_AUTH_TOKEN, CLIPROXY_BASE_URL, CLIPROXY_MODEL, HEADLESS, OPENCODE_BASE_URL, OPENCODE_MODEL, WEB_TASK_API_DATA_DIR, WEB_TASK_API_MODEL, WEB_TASK_API_PI_MODEL, WEB_TASK_API_PI_URL, WEB_TASK_API_PI_VARIANT, WEB_TASK_API_RECIPES_DIR, WEB_TASK_API_TEMP_DIR, WEB_TASK_API_VARIANT

environmentVariables.name: WEB_TASK_API_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional mutable data root for web-task-api runs, sessions, profiles, and temp state. When omitted, the runtime uses a platform user-data directory instead of the ambient cwd.

environmentVariables.name: WEB_TASK_API_RECIPES_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional recipes directory override. When omitted, web-task-api reads bundled recipes from the installed package.

environmentVariables.name: WEB_TASK_API_TEMP_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional temp root override used when incoming temp env variables point at your home directory or working directory.

environmentVariables.name: WEB_TASK_API_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional shared default planner model for catalog-backed PI and OpenCode selections. Defaults to deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash.

environmentVariables.name: WEB_TASK_API_VARIANT
environmentVariables.description: Optional shared default planner thinking variant for catalog-backed PI and OpenCode selections. Defaults to high.

environmentVariables.name: WEB_TASK_API_PI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional PI engine base URL for the preferred planner backend. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8793.

environmentVariables.name: WEB_TASK_API_PI_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional PI-specific planner model override. Defaults to WEB_TASK_API_MODEL when omitted.

environmentVariables.name: WEB_TASK_API_PI_VARIANT
environmentVariables.description: Optional PI-specific thinking variant override. Defaults to WEB_TASK_API_VARIANT when omitted.
